title: AgentEnvelope
description:
v2.0.0 — Universal message wrapper for BibleFi agent communications. Includes routing, security context, Farcaster frame context, and Base chain transaction context. Supports the full agentic scripture-pipeline including task orchestration, run logging, seed batches, and multi-language and theological validation.

MIGRATION FROM v1: The top-level 'correlation_id' field (free string) has been removed. Use 'routing.correlation_id' (UUID v4) instead. All new context fields (routing, security_context, farcaster_context, base_chain_context) are optional and non-breaking.

envelope_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this envelope (UUID v4). NOTE: format:uuid is an assertion in validators that enforce formats (e.g. Ajv with ajv-formats); treat as annotation-only in validators that do not.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the AgentEnvelope schema used (e.g. '2.0.0'). Consumers MUST verify the major version matches the schema $id they resolved (https://schemas.biblefi.io/v2/agent_envelope.schema.json requires 2.x.x).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the envelope was created.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which the envelope should be considered expired. Recipients MUST check this field before processing if replay prevention is required.

payload_type.description: Discriminator indicating which schema governs the contents of the 'payload' field. Payload structure validation is the responsibility of the consumer using the appropriate per-type schema (out-of-band validation).

payload.description: The actual data payload. Must conform to the schema identified by 'payload_type'. Payload validation is out-of-band and performed using the per-type schema. This field intentionally does not enforce additionalProperties to allow flexible payload shapes.

sender.description: Identity of the agent or system that produced this envelope.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the sending agent or service.

agent_type.description: Human-readable type label for the sender (e.g. 'scripture-indexer', 'defi-oracle').

wallet_address.description: Optional EVM-compatible wallet address of the sender on Base chain.

fid.description: Optional Farcaster ID (FID) of the sending user or agent.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature over the canonical JSON of the payload. Recipients MUST verify this signature to establish message integrity and sender authenticity. The presence of a signature does not alone make an envelope trustworthy; verify the signing key against a trusted key registry.

public_key.description: Base64url-encoded public key corresponding to the signing key.

signed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the signature was created. NOTE: This is a self-reported, client-side value. Recipients MUST NOT use signed_at for replay detection without server-side time validation.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for filtering, routing, or indexing.

routing.description: Optional message routing metadata for agent-to-agent communications.

destination_agent.description: Target BibleFi agent ID. Must match an agent defined in AGENT_TAXONOMY.md.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds. Recipients SHOULD discard the envelope if (created_at + ttl_seconds) is in the past.

retry_count.description: Number of times this message has been retried.

correlation_id.description: Groups related messages in a conversation or workflow (UUID v4). MIGRATION: This replaces the v1 top-level 'correlation_id' (free string) which has been removed. NOTE: format:uuid enforcement depends on validator configuration; a pattern constraint ('^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') may be added if strict enforcement is required.

security_context.description: Optional security classification and trust metadata for the envelope. IMPORTANT: All fields in security_context are self-asserted by the sender and MUST NOT be used for access-control, authorization, or privilege-escalation decisions without independent cryptographic verification (e.g. verifying the envelope signature against a trusted key registry, or confirming trust level via a server-side policy engine). See SANDBOXING_POLICY.md and TRUST_BOUNDARIES.md in Biblefi/BibleFi.

classification.description: Self-asserted data classification. Recipients MUST enforce their own access-control policies independently of this field.

requires_verification.description: Self-asserted flag indicating whether the recipient should perform additional verification before processing. Recipients MUST implement the required verification independently.

trust_level.description: Self-asserted trust level per BibleFi TRUST_BOUNDARIES.md. IMPORTANT: 'verified' does not imply cryptographic verification by the schema. Recipients MUST NOT grant elevated permissions based solely on this field. Verify using the envelope signature and a trusted key registry.

sandboxed.description: Whether this envelope originates from a sandboxed agent per SANDBOXING_POLICY.md. Self-asserted; recipients MUST verify sandboxing through runtime infrastructure, not this field.

farcaster_context.description: Present when this envelope originates from a Farcaster Frame interaction. BibleFi is deployed as a native Farcaster mini-app. NOTE: frame_uri may contain user-specific tokens or query parameters; ensure it is not logged or persisted without sanitization.

cast_hash.description: Hash of the Farcaster cast containing the frame. Must not be empty.

fid.description: Farcaster ID (FID) of the interacting user.

frame_action.description: Action taken within the BibleFi Farcaster Frame.

channel_id.description: Farcaster channel where the frame was cast (e.g. /biblefi, /faith, /defi).

frame_uri.description: URI of the BibleFi Farcaster Frame. Ensure query parameters do not contain user-specific tokens or secrets before logging or persisting.

base_chain_context.description: Present when this envelope relates to a Base chain transaction. BibleFi primary chain = Base mainnet (chain_id: 8453).

block_number.description: Block number at which the related transaction was confirmed.

gas_used.description: Gas consumed by the related transaction.

contract_address.description: EVM contract address involved in the related transaction.
